new_findings.title: Cold heartbeat INSERT serializes concurrent server ticks
new_findings.invariant: Heartbeat must not make one server tick wait for another before job selection.
new_findings.trigger: Fresh installation with no runner row; tick A has not committed its first heartbeat and step; tick B enters concurrently.
new_findings.actual: Tick B waits transactionid ShareLock before real output INSERT; warm positive control reaches its independent step.
new_findings.impact: Cold-start concurrency delay. Recovery advances each job once. No incorrect quantity, duplicate output or permanent stall observed.
new_findings.scope_note: Normal one-job pg_cron scheduling does not automatically run concurrent instances; this is the explicit concurrent-server-call capability.
new_findings.suggested_fix: Use a nonblocking initializer/writer guard only for heartbeat; losing tick skips heartbeat and continues job selection. Preserve 8s limit, identity and per-job skip-locked protection.
new_findings.retest: Pin new candidate/tree; cold and warm independently PASS, no duplicate, current access and claims preserved; affected K4/staged/K3 regressions PASS.
